result.description: Childrens Medical Research Institute   Together we are making a difference for kids living with genetic disease.   Children’s Medical Research Institute (CMRI) was Australia’s first dedicated paediatric research facility and is now one of the world’s most highly regarded independent medical research organisations. Our research focuses on the four key areas impacting children’s health: cancer, genomics and genetic diseases, neurobiology, and embryology.      Work with a team of dedicated professionals   We're looking for either an experience Research Assistant or Staff Scientist to provide expert services for the Single Cell Analytics Facility and CellBank at Children’s Medical Research Institute (CMRI), while also supporting other CMRI Research Facilities as needed. This is your opportunity to make a real impact by delivering high-quality services and support across multiple research platforms. In this role, you'll be empowered to work independently, while also contributing to a collaborative and forward-thinking team environment. You’ll work closely with the Scientific Core Facilities Engagement & Service Support Lead and become an integral part of a team that drives innovation and excellence in research.      A rewarding role in every way   · Full time role – 37.5. 12 months Fixed Term contract, with a potential to extend past this point.  · Excellent not for profit tax benefits.  · A flexible and supportive work environment where everyone’s contribution is highly valued.      Benefits   Task & responsibilities   What you'll do:   · Proactively support researchers to achieve their scientific objectives through the provision of single cell analytics and long read sequencing services.  · Prepare technical reports and contribute to research papers.  · Coordinate Single Cell Analytics Facility services with colleagues in other Research Facilities where relevant to streamline and enhance customer experience.  · Assist with Cell Line Testing, Custom Culture and other services offered by CellBank one day per week.  · Assist with iPSC maintenance, expansion and freezing and other service offered by CMRI’s Genome Engineering Facility  · Assist Scientific Core Facilities Engagement & Service Support Lead to identify potential income generating and cost minimisation opportunities which enable the facility to be financially sustainable and implement these initiatives where directed.  · Proactively engage with potential users of the Single Cell Analytics Facility to maximise awareness and utilisation of available single cell analytics capability at CMRI.  · Represent CMRI Research Facilities at conferences, seminars and events  · Actively seek projects which promote development of new capabilities of the Single Cell Analytics Facility  · Undertake administrative duties relevant to the activities of the facility   Qualification & experience   What can you bring to this role?   We are seeking an outgoing and dynamic Research Assistant or Staff Scientist with a passion for laboratory science and stakeholder engagement. The ideal candidate will excel at building relationships with facility users and stakeholders through in-person communication, scientific presentations, and written correspondence. A strong understanding of cell platforms, the specific laboratory equipment, and related software is essential. In this role, you’ll demonstrate advanced lab methods, ensure high-quality specimen preparation, and apply your critical thinking and time management skills to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Our ideal candidate would be someone with:  · Postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline  · Experience in genomics techniques. There is a preference for experience with single cells genomics including and/or scRNAseq and scATACseq, but this is not a must.  · Understanding of the capabilities and applications 10X Genomics and ONT platforms- This is a big bonus, but not a must.  · Proficient in routine cell and molecular biology techniques .  · Experience in mammalian cell culture including iPSCs.  · Knowledge of cell and molecular biology.  · Familiarity with methods related to single cell specimen preparation and image processing/analysis.  · Proficient computational skills and experience with database programs.  About Company     Want to know more about CMRI?    Please visit our website or LinkedIn.  We kindly request no unsolicited resumes or approaches from Recruitment Agencies. We will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.  Children’s Medical Research Institute is an equal-opportunity employer. We are dedicated to attracting, retaining, and developing our people. We embrace diversity and inclusion, we strongly encourage applications from those who identify as being Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander. - Full time opportunities available
- Join the Rimech Engineering team in Henderson

At Rimech Engineering Pty Ltd, we deliver turnkey Structural, Mechanical, and Piping (SMP) solutions across Western Australia with a strong foundation built on ISO-aligned compliance and data-driven project management.

Rimech Engineering are currently looking to fill the following roles:
- Metal Fabricators / Fitters
- Construction Estimator
- Structural Engineer

Metal Fabricators/Fitters: To be considered for this opportunity, you will need to hold relevant trade qualifications and a minimum of 2 years' experience as a Metal Fabricator/Fitter.

You will also demonstrate the following tickets / experience:
- Construction Safety Awareness - White Card
- Emergency Evacuation Drill
- Water Corporation Field Based Work Induction
- Water Corporation Level 1 Lock out Tag out (LOTO)
- RIO Tinto Inductions
- Fire extinguisher training
- SWMS & JSEA Training
- Manual Handling
- Hazardous Materials
- Spill Response

You will be responsible for undertaking work as directed by the Workshop or Site Supervisor, including:
- Receive job brief from Workshop Supervisor or Site Supervisor
- Undertake welding to meet the technical requirements
- Report technical problems to Workshop Supervisor or Site Supervisor
- Report safety issues to Workshop Supervisor or Site Supervisor
- Participate in staff safety meetings
- HSEQ involvement and adherence
- Maintain high standard of housekeeping in workshop
- Work as directed by Workshop Supervisor or Site Supervisor
- Obtain tools/consumables/equipment from store to complete jobs

Construction Estimator: To be considered for this position, you will need to have a minimum of three years estimating experience.

You will also need to have:
- Ability to read, understand and interpret engineering drawings and project documents
- A great communicator able to engage with internal and external stakeholders
- Australian working rights

You will be responsible for:
- Keeping up to date with upcoming tenders and other significant projects
- Assess the viability of projects prior to bid
- Understand client's requirements, standards and specifications
- Perform detailed take-off's of materials
- Apply accurate costing to bids as per company templates
- Follow up on submitted tenders
- Assist with procurement and handover to project management staff
- Scope of works planning and finding cost efficiencies
- Provide advice as per contract documents

Structural Engineer: To be considered for this position, you will need to have a relevant Degree in Engineering Civil or Mechanical, and proven experience working in a similar role.

Responsibilities will include but will not be limited to:
- Receive job briefing from the Project Manager
- Brief workers of work and safety requirements
- Ensure that all plant/equipment is available for the job and fit for purpose
- Supervise workers and ensure that the work performed meets quality, technical and safety requirements
- Resolve onsite problems where they are within your capabilities and authority
- Work cooperatively with the client/ super representative
- Report daily progress, resources and problems to the Project Manager (including HSE reporting requirements)
- Ensure that client requirements are met
- Inform the Project Manager of potential job variations
- Create and update look ahead programs
- Participate in job debrief (if requested by the Project Manager)
- HSEQ involvement and adherence e.g. prestart meetings, tool box meetings, risk assessments, site inspections / audits
- Develop Management Plans & HSE documentation as required
- Develop Design and Shop Drawings. Auto CAD or similar
- Compile and maintain currency of project Quality documentation
- Assist with job progress claims & variation proposals

Remuneration packages between $78,000 - $100,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

https://www.netyourjob.com.au/jobs/17370.php

 Bachelor of Engineering (Civil, Mining or related discipline).

result.description:
Field Service Technician
Premier Tech Systems and Automation Pty Limited
Full-time
130,000 – $140,000 (inclusive of guaranteed allowances) + super

The company

As part of the well-respected and successful international Premier Tech group, and with an
Australian history dating back to the 1950’s, we are a leader within the bulk handling and
packaging equipment industry in Australia.  We are collaborative and innovative, and we love
what we do.

The role

As part of a national team of field service technicians servicing and commissioning a range of
specialised flexible packaging machinery installed around the country and abroad, you will
travel extensively (approx. 75% of the role) throughout metro and regional VIC, as well as
interstate and the occasional international trip. 

Providing expert advice and service for robotic and conventional palletisers, bagging
machines, wrapping and hooding machines and their corresponding control systems, you
should expect to spend most of your time working on customer sites, with the remaining time
spent working between the West Heidelberg office and home.


JOB DESCRIPTION


Fundamental Duties and responsibilities 	

Perform in-house and on-site equipment installations and start-ups  
•	Install equipment at customers’ locations according to safety standards and established corporate procedures 
•	Perform initial start-ups for installed equipment
•	Test and verify installed equipment at customers’ locations
•	Perform tests and verify the proper functioning of equipment
•	Train customers on the proper operation of the equipment
•	Prepare reports on completed installations
•	Do in-house equipment start-ups before it leaves for customers’ locations

Solve various equipment problems for customers
•	Visit customers in order to diagnose equipment problems
•	Find solutions in collaboration with the engineering team
•	Adjust and repair customers’ equipment and ensure it is operated safely and according to the original specifications
•	Prepare reports following service calls
•	Contribute to product development

Do preventive equipment maintenance at various customers’ locations
•	Evaluate the safety, general state and compliance of various equipment
•	Do preventive maintenance and repair on equipment
•	Ensure proper equipment functioning following maintenance visits
•	Plan following maintenance visits as needed
•	Provide on-site and/or remote technical support to clients
•	Prepare reports on the work performed

Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Diagnose problems and identify possible solutions for customers
•	Help customers find safe solutions to problems
•	Promote preventive maintenance and training services to customers

Other generic tasks as required
•	Preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
•	Assisting Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists in the design of mechanical equipment and plant
•	Selecting tools and equipment
•	Assembling and installing new and modified mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools and controls, and hydraulic power systems
•	Estimating material costs and quantities, and machine requirements
•	Performing and directing field and laboratory tests
•	Collecting and analysing data, carrying out complex computations and preparing diagrams
•	Organising and supervising inspection and maintenance of machines and plant
•	Ensuring that designs and finished work are within specifications, regulations and contract provisions
•	Prepares detailed drawings and plans of mechanical engineering work in support of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists.
 


Advanced Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Assume responsibility for a certain type of service or equipment for customers
•	Do relatively complex installations at customers’ locations
•	Solve complex equipment problems for customers 
•	Provide over the phone technical support for customers 
•	Master preventive maintenance of equipment and suggest improvements to customers during service calls
•	Meet the demand for technical information from potential customers and promote Premier Tech products to customers 


•	Expert Duties and responsibilities 	

•	Be the go-to person for the team as work is carried out
•	Be an instructor and mentor for new team members
•	Collaborate in the equipment design process with the engineering team 
•	Help develop and implement work procedures and methods 
•	Organize installations or repair work to be done
•	Develop and provide specific technical service expertise to the team 
•	Apply different analysis and problem solving skills to diagnose and repair a variety of equipment  
•	Resolve unusual, major and complex problems on customers’ equipment
•	Do major and non-standard equipment installations at customers’ sites




 
COMPETENCIES PROFILE

Qualifications

At least a trade qualification, associate diploma in engineering or suitable equivalent mechanical/electrical/electronic/control automation qualification.

Technical competencies 	

•	In-depth specific knowledge of Premier Tech packaging machinery including Bottom-Up Filling Technology is highly desirable.
•	Interpreting mechanical and general assembly drawings
•	Interpreting hydraulic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting pneumatic circuit drawings
•	Interpreting electrical schematics
•	Interpreting general installation and industrial buildings layouts
•	Industrial PLC, networks and communication protocols
•	installation, commissioning and maintenance of industrial robots, packaging and powder conveying systems.
•	Installation and optimisation of pneumatically operated equipment
•	Installation, commissioning and troubleshooting of field devices and instrumentation
•	Installation and commissioning of industrial machinery safety systems and guarding.
•	Safe troubleshooting of partially energised systems
•	Troubleshooting PLCs programs, mechanical and electrical installations.
•	Systems and equipment start-up
•	Equipment preventative maintenance
•	Service reports generation
•	Training of machine Operators and Maintenance Crews
•	English communication


Culture

As a well-respected and successful business, we have a range of long term, loyal and
committed team members, creating a solid team environment and providing job security. We
work hard but always find time for a laugh. We care about our team and strive to be an
employer of choice!

What’s in it for you?

•	Competitive salary + travel allowance
•	A professional and friendly work environment
•	A hybrid work arrangement with opportunity to work from home or office (as required) when
•	not travelling
•	Fabulous Employee Assistance Program that includes telehealth appointments and
•	extends to immediate family members
•	On-going training and development.

How to apply

Please apply with a current CV and a separate cover letter outlining why you think
you are the right person for this opportunity.

Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted and we thank you in advance for
your time and interest in working with us.

We look forward to hearing from you!

result.description: ALUMICORP PTY LTD  We are seeking a reliable and technically skilled Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson to support the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting and improvement of mechanical systems and machinery in our aluminium manufacturing facility.   The Mechanical Engineering Draftsperson is responsible for preparing, modifying and maintaining detailed engineering drawings, fabrication documentation and technical specifications for aluminium products, systems and structures. The role supports the design, manufacturing, fabrication and installation functions by converting engineering concepts, project requirements and client specifications into accurate technical drawings and production-ready documentation.  The successful candidate will contribute to efficient and safe plant operations by ensuring the mechanical integrity and optimal performance of production equipment.   Benefits  Salary: $80,000 - $85,000 plus Super depending on experience      Task & responsibilities  Engineering Drafting and Design Documentation  •    Prepare detailed mechanical and fabrication drawings using Computer-Aided Design (CAD) software.  •    Produce shop drawings, workshop drawings and manufacturing drawings for aluminium products and systems.  •    Develop detailed component, assembly and installation drawings.  •    Prepare engineering layouts, sections, elevations and construction details.  •    Create three-dimensional (3D) models where required for project coordination and visualisation.  •    Prepare drawing packages for fabrication, procurement and site installation purposes.  •    Modify and revise drawings in response to engineering reviews, client requests or project changes.  •    Maintain drawing registers and revision control systems.  Aluminium Product and System Design Support  •    Assist in the design development of aluminium windows, doors, curtain walls, balustrades, louvres, façades, screens, canopies and other aluminium structures.  •    Prepare fabrication details for aluminium extrusions, brackets, frames, supports and associated hardware.  •    Interpret architectural, structural and engineering drawings and convert them into fabrication-ready documentation.  •    Assist engineers in preparing technical solutions to meet project specifications.  •    Ensure compatibility between aluminium systems and associated materials and components.  Manufacturing and Fabrication Support  •    Prepare cutting schedules, fabrication schedules and production documentation.  •    Develop material take-offs and bill of materials (BOMs).  •    Generate fabrication details to optimise manufacturing efficiency and minimise material wastage.  •    Coordinate with production teams regarding fabrication methods and assembly requirements.  •    Review manufacturing constraints and recommend practical design improvements.  •    Assist with the preparation of CNC machine data and production files where applicable.  •    Ensure fabrication drawings accurately reflect approved engineering designs.  Site and Installation Support  •    Conduct site measurements and verification where required.  •    Assist in preparing as-built drawings and project close-out documentation.  •    Provide technical support to installation teams.  •    Investigate and resolve design discrepancies arising during construction.  •    Attend project sites to confirm dimensions, installation requirements and compliance matters when necessary.  Continuous Improvement  •    Contribute to improvements in drafting standards, drawing templates and documentation systems.  •    Assist in implementing new CAD technologies and drafting methodologies.  •    Recommend improvements to fabrication processes and product designs.  •    Participate in training and professional development activities.      Qualification & experience      Relevant AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma   Minimum of 12 months of relevant industry experience    Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-85000   Job Publish:  30-06-2026   Job Expire:  30-07-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5953631   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

Front End Developer (also known as Front End Engineer, Web Developer, Front End Software Developer, Software Developer, CSS Developer, HTML Developer, Programmer, Software Engineer)
The purpose of the Front End Developer is to be a hands-on developer working in a cross discipline team to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Collaborating with other engineers (front-end & back-end), creatives, and clients, the front-end developer may implement web experiences via working in front-end workflows within a project team of technical & non-technical members to help drive business outcomes for our clients.
Working closely with UX designers to translate wireframes, this role also requires maintenance & management of frontend libraries alongside the building, testing & deployment of code.
This position requires a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification. Worked in software engineering roles focussed on front-end development for 4+ years.

Salary: $85K – 105K package

Senior Front End Developer
We are on the hunt for a Senior Front End Developer to be a hands-on developer working with cross discipline teams to deliver the front-end portion of websites & web applications. Leading a team of engineers (front-end & back-end) while working closely with other creative teams and clients, the Senior Front-End Developer is responsible for building & maintaining various features as per clients’ requirements. Back End Developer (also known as Web Developer, Software Engineer, Programmer, Software Developer, Back-End Software engineer)
The Back End Developer is an analytical, goal-oriented person who will work with team members to troubleshoot and improve existing back-end applications and processes. Using their understanding of programming languages and tools, the Back End Developer will analyze current codes and industry developments, formulate more efficient processes & solve problems, to create a more seamless experience for users. The ideal candidate will have excellent communication, computer, and project management skills.
The role will involve: compiling and analysing data, processes, and codes to troubleshoot problems and identify areas for improvement, collaborating with the front-end developers and other team members to establish objectives and enable the design to be more functional, implementing cohesive codes where necessary to enhance the user experience. The back end developer will also be responsible for developing ideas for new programs, features or products via research & monitoring of industry trends.
To succeed as a backend developer, you should be focused on building a better, more efficient program and creating a better end-user experience. You should be knowledgeable, collaborative, and motivated. The ideal candidate will have relevant tertiary qualification in computer programming, computer science or a related field; or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification, but also ideally have a minimum of 2 years experience in a similar role. Fluency or understanding of specific languages, such as Java, PHP, or Python, and operating systems may be required. The candidate will also have a strong understanding of the web development cycle and programming techniques and tools; be focused on efficiency, user experience, and process improvement and also have excellent project and time management skills.
